Folders becoming tags is the right mapping. It retains useful organization without trying to reproduce a browser’s folder tree exactly.

Skipping an address that already exists is also the safer default; don’t overwrite or silently merge into my existing bookmark. The import summary should clearly report how many were skipped so I know what happened.

The standard browser bookmarks HTML format is what I want for import/export, preserving title, tags, and original date. I don’t expect that file to carry notes, read/archive state, or saved page copies, so please describe it as a browser-compatible export rather than a complete backup. With that distinction, import and export feel right.
